1458862350-it.title: Libreria scarsa
1458862350-it.text:
Si dovrebbero aumentare gli esercizi in libreria. Sono troppi pochi e bisogna continuamente aggiungere. Inoltre anche per gli esercizi pre impostati si dovrebbe poter inserire video e immagini personali.

"Hi Hevy Team! I love the app. I have a feature request for time-based/cardio exercises (like HIIT sprints). Currently, the app doesn't have a built-in countdown timer that stops on its own or alerts you when the active time is over. When doing high-intensity sprints on a treadmill, it's impossible to look at the phone. It would be amazing to have a countdown timer with audio/vibration alerts for the active phase, which then automatically triggers the rest timer. Thank you!"

1458862350-it.title: Non male
1458862350-it.text: App molto intuitiva e comoda per segnare le progressioni e i tempi di recupero, ampia gamma di esercizi pre-registrati con piccolo video dimostrativo dell’esecuzione. Un po’ macchinoso nella gestione delle schede di allenamento poiché lo svolgimento di una preclude la possibilità di segnare esercizi inseriti in altre schede.

1458862350-it.title: Da migliorare
1458862350-it.text: Un app utilissima e molto ben fatta! Unico neo, dovrebbe essere possibile configurarla anche per gli orologi Garmin, non solo per Apple Watch.

1458862350-it.title: Consigliata ma il limite di 4 schede di allenamento proprio no
1458862350-it.text: L’applicazione è super funzionale, fatta molto bene seppur in modo semplice in sé. Carino il report mensile, ma superfluo. Sarebbe magnifico poter esportare un json degli allentamenti/schede. Tuttavia il limite di 4 schede massimo di allenamento per la versione gratuita è veramente scomodo. Non capisco perché dovrei pagare per aggiungere delle schede, personali create da me. Piuttosto torno ad usare le note dell’iPhone.

6443740936-us.title: PLEASE FIX THIS PLEASE! 🙏🏻
6443740936-us.text: Rest timer notifications are not vibrating, just the sound and the issue continues on iOS 27 as well.

6443740936-us.title: Feels like AI based app. I could be better, it’s not as great as in looks.
6443740936-us.text: It uses the same muscles names for every specific workout. Which, I do kinda like it uses the scientific name. But it doesn’t help when you want to workout specific parts of your muscles. Like example: for chest it uses the same muscle and all the workouts don’t specify which part of the chest is being worked out. Like I would really like if it said stuff like “upper chest” “lower chest” but it doesn’t specify, its just says the whole chest because technically yeah they all have the same scientific name. Not only that you see multiple of the same looking exercises with a bit of a different name but it would work out same thing on your body. The same looking workouts as you scroll constantly makes it feel like you’re not getting anywhere which feels like it’s more ran by an AI rather than real people. Which, I don’t have a problem but if you want authentic its not really giving that vibe here.

6443740936-us.title: NOT FREE
6443740936-us.text: Seen the reviews saying it was free and was excited to download. Upon actually downloading app and going through the sign up process, once I get to the last page it says it’s free for 2 weeks and then $60/year. Such a waste of time.

6443740936-us.title: Disgusting
6443740936-us.text: I should not scroll through a workout app and see “Gestapo amazing”. Do you have any idea how offensive that is? I refuse to use this app or recommend it to anyone based on the insensitivity and disgusting nature of including such a workout. You should be ashamed.

6443740936-us.title: Deceiving
6443740936-us.text: Yet another app that suggests there are some simple, free capabilities but then forces you to pay and subscribe after a trial period. Why not make a great app with limited free features and then make it a no brainer that I should upgrade to a paid plan. Just awful.

6443740936-us.title: Not “free” as advertised
6443740936-us.text: As soon as you create a login and answer questions about your goals, you’re  required to start a subscription. The description in the AppStore stated this was a free workout tracker. It is not. False advertising.

6443740936-us.title: NOT FREE
6443740936-us.text: Another scam so that’s free until you actually want to use it. Unless you want to pay $60 don’t download this.

6443740936-us.title: Don’t get duped
6443740936-us.text: This app is full of typos, workouts in languages I don’t know, and uses cutesy anime images to describe workout programs. I expected a lot more given the reviews I read. And those hundreds of “free” programs… I never saw any of those. Canceled within 24 hours. Total junk.

6443740936-us.title: Needs More
6443740936-us.text: I do really enjoy this app, but my own personal opinion is that it needs more full body compounds like squat to curl to press or reverse lung to overhead press, just as examples. Sometimes I can be pressed for time so to get more bang for my buck time wise, compound movements are great, I just can’t use the app when I’m doing those.

6443740936-us.title: Routine: “Workout not found” errors
6443740936-us.text: I really like this app but there are a lot of duplicate exercises. If you setup a routine and sift through all the exercises, sometimes you get a “routine not found “ error. This means all the time you spent adding exercises to a routine are lost . It’s infuriating.

6443740936-us.title: Would Have Been Great
6443740936-us.text: Would have but each time you attempt to save exercises into a workout, they don't save. It's so frustrating that you just give up. Nice app but if I can't quickly save my exercises, then it's pointless. I'll wait to see what updates are made.

6443740936-us.title: Double counts calories in Apple Fitness
6443740936-us.text: I absolutely LOVE this app, but I hope the developers see this because whenever I use the Apple to track the workouts, it counts my active calories as active calories and calories burned from the workout so my active calories in the Fitness app is doubles from my workouts so it’s not accurately tracking that. Please fix this because this is the best workout tracker I’ve ever used!!!

6443740936-us.title: Cool app BUT…
6443740936-us.text: I’ve been using this app for almost a year and I love it. However I’ve got disappointed. I’ve never used the feature to upload a photo, until now that I started to wanting to track my progress at least visually. The problem is that if you upload it directly from the camera, once you upload it you don’t have a way to download it. It should either leave a copy of that photo in your photos app  or at least allow you to download it. Yes I know it allows you to share it as a story or download it but if you share it as a story it adds some stats which can’t be removed, and if you save it, it will only save the stats with a grey background instead the picture. It doesn’t say anywhere that that is a premium feature and why would keeping your own picture be a premium feature anyways. If you tell me that the photo is included in the workout analysis screen ok I’m willing to upgrade but then make sure to specify that in the upgrade to premium screen which now it doesn’t say anything just the price.  Also there should be a way to change the units for exercises time based so that at least we log the time we start performing an exercise and the progress overtime. I hope you guys read this and can improve that. Thank you!

6443740936-us.title: Inaccurate muscle data
6443740936-us.text: Lats, traps, and erectors were put in the same category, basically making it a whole set of data for a muscle instead of making it a different muscle group data for each one of them, and adding low and high-lat fibers for different lat movements would be great. And for triceps please add medial, lateral, and long head muscle fibers please not just making it at one same with the back muscle. Leg muscles are unduly specific while the upper body muscles aren’t. Thank you please improve your app.
